title: Investigate CI pnpm install reliability (June 9 transient failure)
body: CI run 27201513282 (June 9) showed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @/ path aliases in unit tests, but subsequent runs (June 10, 16, 17) all passed. This was a transient CI runner issue, not a code defect. No action needed unless the pattern recurs.
rationale: The transient June 9 CI failure has not recurred on subsequent runs. The fast-gate job has no node_modules cache — if install is interrupted, module resolution fails. Monitor for recurrence.

title: Align @commitlint/cli and @commitlint/config-conventional versions
body: The PR bumps @commitlint/config-conventional to 21.0.2 but leaves @commitlint/cli at ^20.5.0. While semver-compatible, version 21.x of config-conventional likely requires a matching 21.x cli for full compatibility. Consider bumping cli alongside config.
rationale: Mismatched commitlint tool versions could cause unexpected lint behavior, though not currently causing CI failures.

title: Fix kody preview build — Fly.io app repository not found
body: The 'kody' check on PR #16 fails because the Fly.io preview app (kp-866cab-523991-pr-16) does not exist: 'app repository not found'. This is a Fly.io infrastructure issue, not a code defect. The CI pipeline (Fast Gate, Integration Tests, Build) is green. Check if the preview app needs to be recreated or if the app name has changed in the kody preview configuration.
rationale: The kody preview build failure blocks PR merge despite passing CI. It is a Fly.io deployment infrastructure issue unrelated to the commitlint version bump.
